title: Rapid Ricotta-Spinach Ravioli & Red Pesto
subtitle: with Rana Pasta, Pine Nuts & Cherry Tomato Salad
description: Indulge in pure trattoria-style luxury with Rana’s spinach and ricotta ravioli, brimming with a rich, earthy filling that delivers restaurant quality decadence straight to your plate. Gently tossed with red pesto and topped with delicious Parmesan and pine nuts for crunch, it’s a luscious, ready-made dinner that punches well above its weight.

steps.text:
• Boil the kettle.
• Half-fill a large saucepan with boiling water and add a generous pinch of salt.
• Cook Rana ricotta & spinach ravioli over high heat until ‘al dente’, 3 minutes.
• Reserve pasta water (see ingredients). Drain ravioli, then return to the saucepan.
• TIP: Fresh pasta moves quickly! 3 minutes is all it needs to hit that perfect ‘al dente’ bite.
• TIP: The pasta will naturally separate as it cooks!

• When the ravioli is done, heat a large frying pan over medium-low heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• Add light cooking cream and the reserved pasta water and simmer until slightly reduced, 2-3 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
• Remove from heat, then stir through red pesto and cooked ravioli until combined. Season to taste with pepper.

• Meanwhile, halve snacking tomatoes. Slice lemon into wedges.
• In a medium bowl, combine rocket leaves, tomatoes, a drizzle of olive oil and a good squeeze of lemon juice. Season to taste.
• TIP: Toss the salad just before serving to keep the leaves crisp.

• Divide ricotta-spinach ravioli and cherry tomato salad between plates.
• Sprinkle over Parmesan cheese and pine nuts (see ingredients) to serve. Enjoy!
